name: Continuous agent evaluation
summary: Foundry Observability auto-scoring of live agent traces — does the judge model accept BYOM?
description: Continuous evaluation samples production agent traces from Application Insights at a configured rate and scores them with the selected evaluators (task adherence, coherence, groundedness, rubric, safety). Each rule picks its own judge model. BYOM question: can the rule's judge deployment be `{conn}/{model}`, and does the sampled scoring call route through the AI Gateway?
notes:
Not yet probed against Foundry because the test environment needs Observability setup, trace traffic, and sampler delay. Docs: https://learn.microsoft.com/azure/foundry/observability/how-to/continuous-evaluation-agents.

A useful probe would wire the project to Application Insights, enable continuous evaluation, choose judge models per rule, generate trace traffic, then confirm judge invocations appear in APIM logs with `{connection}/{deployment}` routing intact.
